import heapq
from collections import deque

def sum_of_largest_keys(N, K, keys):
    MOD = 1000000007
    
    # Sort keys in descending order
    keys.sort(reverse=True)
    
    # Use a max-heap to keep track of the smallest of the largest K elements
    max_heap = []
    for i in range(K):
        heapq.heappush(max_heap, keys[i])
    
    # Calculate the sum of the largest K elements
    current_sum = sum(max_heap)
    
    # Slide the window of size K over the sorted keys
    for i in range(K, N):
        # Remove the smallest element from the current window
        smallest_in_window = heapq.heappop(max_heap)
        # Add the new element to the window
        heapq.heappush(max_heap, keys[i])
        # Update the current sum
        current_sum += keys[i] - smallest_in_window
        # Take modulo 1000000007
        current_sum %= MOD
    
    return current_sum
